name: WadeBush Editor Controls
author: wadebush

sections.description:
WadeBush Editor Controls brings back the familiar editing screen for posts and pages. It is designed for site owners, clients and editorial teams who prefer the traditional WordPress writing experience.

The free edition is fully functional and has no trial period, tracking or usage limits.

Free features

  • Enable or disable classic editor controls
  • Use the Classic Editor for posts
  • Use the Classic Editor for pages
  • Simple settings under Settings > WadeBush Editor Controls
  • No external services or tracking

Pro features

WadeBush Editor Controls Pro adds:

  • Individual selection for any public post type, including products and custom content
  • User-role targeting
  • Per-post and per-page editor overrides
  • Classic Widgets screen control
  • Core and remote block-pattern control
  • Block directory control

View WadeBush Editor Controls Pro
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WadeBush Editor Controls.
  2. Go to Settings > WadeBush Editor Controls.
  3. Choose posts, pages or both.
  4. Save the settings and open a post or page.
sections.faq:
Does this remove my block-editor content?

No. The plugin changes which editor WordPress opens. It does not delete post or page content.

Can I switch back to the Block Editor?

Yes. Disable the relevant option or deactivate the plugin.

Does the free edition work with custom post types?

The free edition supports posts and pages. The Pro edition provides individual controls for public custom post types.

What happens if Free and Pro are both active?

The free edition stays inactive while Pro is running, preventing duplicate editor rules.
